name: Espada
description: The Lamborghini Espada (1968–1978) was a full four-seater grand touring coupe powered by a V12 engine — an improbable combination that Bertone's Marcello Gandini made dramatic. 1,217 were built across three series, making it the best-selling Lamborghini of its era.
